segments.hakka_romanization: Hakka phèn-yû, ngài chhiu he Hak-kâ-ngìn.
segments.english: Hakka friends, I am a Hakka person.
segments.dutch: Hakka-vrienden, ik ben een Hakka.
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_romanization: Ngâ-têu yu he Hak-kâ-ngìn.
segments.english: You all are also Hakka people.
segments.dutch: Jullie zijn ook Hakka.
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_romanization: Ngài-têu lòi cho phèn-yû â.
segments.english: Let's be friends.
segments.dutch: Laten we vrienden worden.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch cross-checked from verified pair

segments.hakka_romanization: Kien-tó mien, ngì ham ngài, ngài ham ngì mâ hó.
segments.english: When we meet, whether you greet me or I greet you is fine.
segments.dutch: Als we elkaar ontmoeten, maakt het niet uit of jij mij begroet of ik jou.
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_characters: 大家都係一樣嘅，冇高冇低。
segments.hakka_romanization: Thai-kâ tû he yit-yong ke, mò kô mò tâi.
segments.english: Everyone is the same, no one is higher or lower.
segments.dutch: Niet hoger of lager (allemaal gelijk).
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch cross-checked from verified pair

segments.hakka_romanization: Ngì thùng ngài seu, ngài yâ thùng ngì seu.
segments.english: You laugh with me, and I also laugh with you.
segments.dutch: Jij lacht met mij en ik lach ook met jou.
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_romanization: Ngì ngiâ ngài ok, ngài yâ thùng ngì ok.
segments.english: If you provoke me to be fierce, I will be fierce with you too.
segments.dutch: Als je mij uitdaagt, word ik ook boos op jou.
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_characters: 你愛打，𠊎也同你打。哈哈哈！
segments.hakka_romanization: Ngì oi tá, ngài yâ thùng ngì tá. Hahaha!
segments.english: If you want to fight, I'll fight with you too. Hahaha!
segments.dutch: Als je wilt vechten, vecht ik ook met je. Hahaha!
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_romanization: Hak-kâ-ngìn he án-ngióng ke â?
segments.english: Are Hakka people like that?
segments.dutch: Zijn Hakka-mensen zo?
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_romanization: He án-ngióng ke lò.
segments.english: Yes, like that.
segments.dutch: Zo is het.
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_characters: 客家人惡，唔係無緣無故惡咩。
segments.hakka_romanization: Ngài kóng, Hak-kâ-ngìn ok, m̀-he mò-yèn-mò-ku ok mê.
segments.english: I say, Hakka people aren't fierce without a reason.
segments.dutch: Ik zeg: Hakka-mensen zijn niet zonder reden fel.
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review
segments.notes: Includes off-camera question at the start

segments.hakka_characters: 你好𠊎好嘛，兩家都好嘛，就毋會惡囉。
segments.hakka_romanization: Ngì hó ngài hó mâ, lióng-kâ tû hó mâ, chhiu m̀-voi ok lò.
segments.english: As long as you're good and I'm good, both sides are good, then we won't be fierce.
segments.dutch: Als jij goed bent en ik goed ben, en beide kanten goed zijn, worden we niet fel.
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_characters: 你過分過頭，就會打你囉。哈哈哈！
segments.hakka_romanization: Ngì ko-fun ko-thèu, chhiu voi tá ngì lò. Hahaha!
segments.english: If you go too far, then I'll hit you. Hahaha!
segments.dutch: Als je te ver gaat, sla ik je. Hahaha!
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_romanization: Hak-kâ-ngìn, lòi thai-kâ khîn-kâi!
segments.english: Hakka people, come let's all chat!
segments.dutch: Kom, laten we allemaal gezellig praten.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch cross-checked from verified pair

segments.hakka_romanization: Ngài-têu thai-kâ tû kí-sṳ̍p se lò.
segments.english: We are all decades old now.
segments.dutch: We zijn allemaal al tientallen jaren oud.
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_romanization: Ngì fôn-hí, ngài yu fôn-hí.
segments.english: When you're happy, I'm happy too.
segments.dutch: Als jij blij bent, ben ik ook blij.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch cross-checked from verified pair

segments.hakka_characters: 你見到𠊎又笑，𠊎見到你也笑。
segments.hakka_romanization: Ngì kien-tó ngài yu seu, ngài kien-tó ngì yâ seu.
segments.english: When you see me you smile, and when I see you I smile too.
segments.dutch: Als je me ziet, lach je, en als ik jou zie, lach ik ook.
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_characters: 見到呢，毋使講乜人請乜人飲茶，你請𠊎、𠊎請你都好。
segments.hakka_romanization: Kien-tó nê, m̀-sṳ́ kóng mak-ngìn chhiáng mak-ngìn yím-chhà, ngì chhiáng ngài, ngài chhiáng ngì tû hó.
segments.english: When we meet, no need to worry who treats whom to tea—you treat me or I treat you, either is fine.
segments.dutch: Als we elkaar ontmoeten, hoeven we ons geen zorgen te maken over wie wie op thee trakteert — jij trakteert mij of ik trakteer jou, allebei is goed.
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_romanization: Thai-kâ fôn-fôn-hí-hí!
segments.english: Everyone happy and joyful!
segments.dutch: Iedereen blij en vrolijk!
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_romanization: Hak-kâ-moi, ngìn-kien-ngìn-oi.
segments.english: Hakka girls, loved by everyone who sees them.
segments.dutch: Hakka-meisjes zijn geliefd bij iedereen.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch cross-checked from verified pair

segments.hakka_romanization: Fó-chhâ lòi chai, Giu Lon Poi!
segments.english: The train comes to pick them up, Giu Lon Poi!
segments.dutch: De trein komt hen ophalen, Giu Lon Poi!
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review
segments.notes: Giu Lon Poi is retained as an unexplained expression

segments.english: What is Giu Lon Poi?
segments.dutch: Wat is Giu Lon Poi?
segments.verification_status: Cantonese and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_characters: 狗吠啦！汪汪汪汪，汪汪汪！哈哈！
segments.hakka_romanization: Kéu phoi lâ! Wong-wong-wong-wong, wong-wong-wong! Haha!
segments.english: A dog barking! Woof woof woof woof, woof woof woof! Haha!
segments.dutch: Blaffende hond.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch cross-checked from verified pair

segments.hakka_romanization: Phò-phò ló lò, m̀-kóng kám tô.
segments.english: Granny is old now, won't talk too much.
segments.dutch: Hakka-broeders en -zussen, bedankt.
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_characters: 客家哥、客家嫂，唔該你啊。
segments.hakka_romanization: Hak-kâ-kô, Hak-kâ-só, m̀-kôi ngì â.
segments.english: Hakka brothers and sisters, thank you.
segments.dutch: Wat aardig dat je kijkt, heel erg bedankt.
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_romanization: Kám pûn-mien â, tô-chhia ngì â.
segments.english: So kind of you to give face (watch), thank you very much.
segments.dutch: Hartelijk dank.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch cross-checked from verified pair

segments.hakka_romanization: Kiûng-hí fat-chhòi! Sîn-ngièn chhiu lòi lò.
segments.english: Congratulations and be prosperous! The New Year is almost here.
segments.dutch: Gefeliciteerd en veel voorspoed! Het nieuwe jaar komt eraan.
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_romanization: Oi kí-tô chhon kí-tô!
segments.english: Earn as much as you wish!
segments.dutch: Verdien zoveel als je wilt!
segments.verification_status: Hakka and English user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.hakka_characters: 賺到哈哈笑，盤滿缽滿啊！
segments.hakka_romanization: Chhon-tó ha-ha-seu, phàn-mân-pot-mân â!
segments.english: Earn until you laugh out loud, with bowls and pots overflowing (abundant wealth)!
segments.dutch: Overvloedige rijkdom.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch cross-checked from verified pair
